description: Result bridge for a month: EBITDA, EBIT and net income from a comparison value to actual, step by step per P&L category. READ ONLY. compare_to: previous_month, previous_quarter_month, previous_year or budget (plan_id optional, only with budget; default is the active plan of the year of the period, without one the call fails with NO_ACTIVE_BUDGET_PLAN). All amounts are result impact (revenue +, expense -, positive = improves the result; deltas = actual - comparison). start/end come from the computed metrics, the steps from category deltas, check.reconciles proves they add up (on unrounded values). unassigned = result change no category of this metric explains (labels without id or subtotal group, accounts without label); excluded lists what is left out (unlabeled_accounts, labels_without_group) and a warning appears when either is non-empty. rounding_difference = end - (start + steps + other + unassigned) on the rounded figures, draw it as a last tiny bar or absorb it. Steps carry sort_order (P&L order) and auffaellig; the list is sorted by absolute delta. Small steps (below other_threshold, share of the absolute total change, default 0.05) are collapsed into other with their list. Use this instead of subtracting category totals yourself.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

other_threshold.description: Share (0..0.5, default 0.05) of the absolute total change below which categories are collapsed into other

plan_id.description: UUID of the budget plan; only with compare_to budget. Omitted: active plan of the year

name: get-variance-bridge
